notes.title: Narvas Update - Version 29.11.20
notes.content:
November 29th, 2020 - Version 29.11.20 - Will update to include more of the changes in this version, it was a lot and I didn't keep track very well.
-2 new levels
-Changes made to Toby-
   Removed Toby's special attack
   Toby now emits emp blast when fully charged
   As Toby, Static button creates a shield over Mace
   As Toby, Fire button creates chain reaction between Toby and Mace's gun
   As Toby, when you run out of energy or stop controlling a solid block is created for platforming or for a shield
   Updated AI
-Removed lives system
-New variations of enemies
-New enemy placements
-Level structures updated
-New and Changed Tiles
-New sprite for platforms and disappearing blocks
-New sprite for door/platform triggers, make sure you are on the lookout for them
-Triggers now take time to activate rather than instantly
-Checkpoint system, each level come with 1-2 checkpoints at some point during the level automatically
-Health recharge station placed in every level
-New Title screen
-Updated dialogue
-New music
-New sound effects
